logp.method_description: The hydrophobicity values of complexes 3d, 3e, 4d and 4e were measured by the “shake flask” method in octanol-water phase partitions. The stock solutions of complexes 3d, 3e, 4d and 4e (2 × 10-5 mol/L) were formulated by octanol saturated with water and then diluted to: 2 × 10-6 mol/L, 4 × 10-6 mol/L, 6 × 10-6 mol/L, 8 × 10-6 mol/L, and 1 × 10-5 mol/L, respectively. The corresponding standard curve and linear regression equation of complexes 3d, 3e, 4d and 4e were obtained by determination the absorbance with UV–Vis spectrophotometer. The above reserve solution (2 × 10-5 mol/L) was precisely measured and added to an aqueous solution saturated with n-octanol of the same volume, and the n-octanol phase was absorbed after shaking and the maximum absorbance value A0 was measured. The water-octanol partition coefficient of complexes 3d, 3e, 4d and 4e can be obtained according to the equation: Log P = log (C0/CW) = log C0/(Csingle bondC0). C0 is the concentration of complexes in the organic phase after shaking; CW is the concentration of complexes in the aqueous phase after shaking; C is the concentration of stock solution.
